review_mode.label: blind-ish strict pixel review
review_mode.procedure: Judge the saved pixels against the five run-local gates at their declared scales; prompt and candidate text were not reconsulted while assigning statuses.
review_mode.limitation: The reviewer had prior run context, so this is blind-ish rather than a fully blinded independent review.

hard_gates.evidence: At 384x512, a large bounded skin-toned oval centered on the upper and middle back is immediately readable inside the black dress silhouette.
At 1086x1448, finished black fabric runs continuously from both shoulder panels down both lateral opening edges and closes at the waist seam around the oval.
A centered silver fastening is visibly closed at the nape, with the lower opening anchored into the fitted waist seam while the wearer is in motion.
At both scales, dense black fabric visibly wraps the front-side bust line beneath the arms and continues as a solid fitted one-piece panel over the pelvis.

At both scales, the opening is exposed skin bounded by the dress itself; gathered hair remains above the edge, the textile is solid and opaque, and the silhouette reads as one closed-front dress rather than an open outer layer.

representative_promotion.reason: This run is technical evidence only; direct requesting-user judgment is pending and representative promotion is forbidden for this arm.

review_boundary: The 5/5 result is a same-image technical pixel-gate judgment. It does not establish identity, same-person correspondence, sensitive attributes, attractiveness, or user preference.
